# Paid Pilot Onboarding Checklist

Copy this checklist for each paid pilot customer.

## Customer

- Customer:
- Pilot sponsor:
- Technical owner:
- PR reviewers:
- Start date:
- Closeout date:

## Candidate Flows

- [ ] Approved spec to PR:
- [ ] Bug ticket to failing test plus fix PR:
- [ ] PR review feedback to updated PR branch:
- [ ] Dependency/API migration PR:
- [ ] Small refactor with test verification:
- [ ] Security fix:

## Environment

- [ ] Repository checkout path confirmed.
- [ ] Package manager and install command confirmed.
- [ ] Verification command confirmed.
- [ ] Branch naming and PR policy confirmed.
- [ ] Least-privilege GitHub token or GitHub CLI access configured.
- [ ] Agent CLI credentials configured in the customer environment.
- [ ] `nitely.context.json` reviewed for sensitive repos.
- [ ] `.nitely` retention expectations documented.

## First Run

- [ ] Low-risk task selected.
- [ ] Flow file selected.
- [ ] Inputs prepared.
- [ ] Dry-run or validation command completed.
- [ ] Generated PR reviewed by customer owner.
- [ ] Run blocker/retry/reflection output reviewed.

## Weekly Review

- [ ] Reviewable PR count:
- [ ] Merged PR count:
- [ ] Senior-engineer cleanup time avoided:
- [ ] Repeated flow usage:
- [ ] Recoverable failures:
- [ ] Evidence gaps:
- [ ] Flow changes needed:

## Closeout

- [ ] Continue, expand, or stop decision recorded.
- [ ] Before/after summary written.
- [ ] Team-control-plane requirements extracted.
- [ ] Follow-up issues linked.
